rv.q: One thing you can’t accuse Stargazers of is being dull.
The script is ambitious but needs fine-tuning in the number of ideas presented that require more solid development.
Stargazers is either terrible or the work of a writer with an entirely original sensibility -- I don't know which.

cn.t: Holmquist's unconventional play captivates with its original sensibility and dark humor, breaking traditional rules while keeping audiences gripped and engaged throughout its strange, promising exploration of land and history.
